==Overview==
* Imperial treasury during this season announced by the Civil Service at 1949 thrones and 2 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 28 thrones donated to the treasury by '''Severin Teyhard von Holberg''' of the House of Seven Mirrors after the Autumn Equinox 383YE
** 10 thrones donated to the treasury by the Chapter Reumah's Redoubt after Autumn Equinox 383YE

===Announcements===
* The [[Keeper of the Breadbasket]] announced that the Breadbasket would support the [[Citadel Guard]]
* The [[Minister of Historical Research]] announced a project to [[Research black lotus]]
* The [[Advisor on the Vallorn]] announced a project to [[Research the Heirs of Terunael]]
* The [[Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]] announced that the Guerdon would be applied to the following for the coming season: the Wolves of War, the Tusks, the Fist of the Mountain, the Winter Sun, the Valiant Pegasus, and to the defence of Hercynia.
* The [[Imperial Master of Works]] announced [[Improve Reumah's Rest II|Improve Reumah's Rest]]
* The [[Imperial Spymaster]] announced [[Construct spy network in Skallahn]]
* [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave|Imperial Wayleave]]: Announcement by Nathaniel of Balthazar’s Vineyard to [[Construct Pegasus Respite]]
* Imperial Wayleave: Announcement by Palerictus Dura to [[Construct Skarsind College of Pitfighting]]
* [[Imperial Orc Wayleave]]: Announcement by Palerictus Krunk to [[Construct Forest of Defiance]]
